text: Playing Tag in Night Sakura World
The monsters seem to have escaped into Twilight Sakura\nCastle. Find them in the castle!
The monsters seem to be running around in the castle.\nFind and catch Cerabes that is running around\nin the big room!
Viscum seems to have taken Cerabes with him and\nrun upstairs. Move upstairs to chase them!
Deniala created a wall that is hindering the pursuit.\nDestroy the crystals which are the power source of the wall\nand head upstairs!
The monsters merged into Amalgam and his miasma nullifies\nattacks. Collect the materials needed to unseal the\nfairy sword in the castle to clear it!
Caylass cleared the miasma with the power of the unsealed\nfairy sword and Amalgam became attackable!\nDefeat it and get Twilight Sakura Castle back!
